name: snRNA-seq of human optic nerve and optic nerve head - oligodendrocytes
description: We identified 5 cell types/states of oligodendrocytes from over 270,000 snRNA-seq cells derived from human optic nerve and optic nerve head.

labelsets.name: author_cell_type
labelsets.description: We used scVI for data integration and then manually annotated each cell cluster with scanpy based on marker gene expression.

labels.name: OLIGO_LRRC7-hi
